title: The Gunslinger
author: Stephen King
summary: In a barren, half-ruined world, a lone gunman pursues a mysterious man in black across the desert. Along the way he meets a boy and recalls the life that brought him here.
readIf: you like strange, stripped-back Westerns that blend fantasy, horror and myth.
skipIf: you want a clear, fast story; this opening volume is fragmented and holds back most of its answers.

pairings.reason: Another spare, harsh journey across a ruined landscape that leaves readers with more questions than answers.
A gritty fantasy with a rough, weary tone and morally mixed heroes.
The author's own epic of the end of the world, set in a world that overlaps this one's themes.
